name: Tsukitomo. - Tsukiuta. 12 Memories -
source: In this "communication adventure", the player has to find pictures of the idols of Procellarum and Six Gravity in order to help them relive their memories! With new CGs and highly polished 2DLive sprites, this game will be a delight to all Tsukiuta fans!
